key_reasoning.reason: Diffstat reports 8 files (5 source, 3 test), which maps to L under the actual-mode file-count table. All of them sit in src/pages/applications/hosted plus the hosted application entity type, and the diff is a net deletion (91 insertions, 169 deletions), so the L score comes from the file count, not from how much work the change took.

The closest pattern already existed: hostedAccess.canShare reads can_share, and the hostedActions menu already gated items by access flags. The change routes the Share action and the Shared-with panel (HostedApplicationDetails, HostedApplicationOverview) through that pattern and removes the moderator revoke_link item from useHostedCardActions. The base score is S, bumped to M because the change alters authorization-driven UI visibility. The server stays the authority through can_share.

The scope was clear, but follow-up commits reworded the access hint for managers who are not the creator and kept a manager's own grant in Shared with. That means minor details were settled during implementation.
